data.title: Insurer requests missing documents for Hausrat water damage claim
data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG writes about Mara Beispiel's household contents (Hausrat) insurance claim HR-26-0331-778 for water damage reported on 19.03.2026. The insurer still needs a list of the damaged items with purchase receipts and photos of the damage, to be submitted within 10 working days of this letter dated 27.03.2026, otherwise it will decide the claim based on the file alone.
data.explanation: Your household contents insurer needs proof before it can finish assessing your water damage claim. Put together a list of everything that was damaged, add the purchase receipts you still have, and take photos of the damage. Send all of this to the insurer by the deadline shown. If you don't, the letter says the insurer will decide the claim based only on the information already on file (Aktenlage), which could mean a lower payout or a denied claim. If you're missing some receipts, note that and consider asking the insurer or an advisor how to substantiate value another way.
